benchmarks.voa_band_h_basis: VOA CTSOP1.1 band H at 31 March 2025 by 2021 LSOA, apportioned to July 2024 constituencies by output-area census household shares

description: Microcosm-derived counts of dwellings valued above thresholds, by area, from HM Land Registry Price Paid Data uprated with the UK HPI and placed through the NSPL and the committed England-and-Wales atomic support (microcosm#1240, fix 2). Not Chronicle facts.

parameters.bulk_transfer_rule: transfers sharing completion date, price and postcode across more than one dwelling are not valuations
parameters.coverage_rule: VOA CTSOP1.1 all properties over valued dwellings ever sold, per local authority, clipped to [0.5, 3.0]
parameters.owner_occupied_share_rule: Census 2021 TS054 owner-occupied share of the private-sector stock (all households less social rented) by local authority, rescaled by one factor so the England share of dwellings over £2m equals one minus the OBR costing's non-owner-occupied share
parameters.uprating: UK HPI by local authority and property type to the calendar-year average, falling back to region then nation, Isles of Scilly to Cornwall
